local platform = workspace:WaitForChild("Platform")
local startCF = platform.CFrame
local offset = Vector3.new(8, 0, 0)
local duration = 3

local function tweenTo(targetCF)
	local conn
	local start = startCF
	local t = 0
	conn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		t += dt
		local alpha = math.clamp(t / duration, 0, 1)
		platform.CFrame = start:Lerp(targetCF, alpha)
		if alpha >= 1 then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		tweenTo(startCF + offset)
		task.wait(duration)
		tweenTo(startCF)
		task.wait(duration)
	end
end)

	else

	end
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ITEMS = {
	Sword = {
		Price = 100,
		Tool = "Sword", -- name of the Tool in ServerStorage
	},
}

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "BuyItem"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function giveItem(player: Player, itemName: string)
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local toolTemplate = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(ITEMS[itemName].Tool)
	if not toolTemplate then
		return false
	end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not backpack then
		return false
	end
	toolTemplate:Clone().Parent = backpack
	return true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName: unknown)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	if coins.Value < item.Price then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= item.Price
	if not giveItem(player, itemName) then
		coins.Value += item.Price -- refund if item couldn't be given
	end
end)

buyPotion.Name = "BuyPotion"
buyPotion.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local POTION_COST = 25

buyPotion.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, quantity)
	if typeof(quantity) ~= "number" then
		return
	end

	quantity = math.floor(quantity)
	if quantity < 1 or quantity > MAX_PER_PURCHASE then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	local potions = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

	local totalCost = quantity * POTION_COST
	if coins.Value < totalCost then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= totalCost
	potions.Value += quantity
end)

-- ServerScriptService/PetRenameServer.lua

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create the RemoteEvent if it doesn't already exist
local renamePetEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RenamePet")
if not renamePetEvent then
	renamePetEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	renamePetEvent.Name = "RenamePet"
	renamePetEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 24

local function sanitizeName(rawName: string): string
	local cleaned = rawName:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if #cleaned > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		cleaned = cleaned:sub(1, MAX_NAME_LENGTH)
	end
	return cleaned
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	-- Create the PetName StringValue if it doesn't already exist
	local petNameValue = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if not petNameValue then
		petNameValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
		petNameValue.Name = "PetName"
		petNameValue.Value = "Pet"
		petNameValue.Parent = player
	end

	-- Listen for rename requests from this player's client
	local connection
	connection = renamePetEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(firingPlayer: Player, newName: unknown)
		if firingPlayer ~= player then
			return -- Never trust the client; only accept renames for the firing player
		end
		if typeof(newName) ~= "string" then
			return
		end

		local cleaned = sanitizeName(newName)
		if #cleaned == 0 then
			return
		end

		petNameValue.Value = cleaned
	end)

	player.Destroying:Connect(function()
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

local CoinManager = {}

function CoinManager.addCoins(userId: number, amount: number): number
	local key = "Player_" .. userId

	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return PlayerData:UpdateAsync(key, function(data)
			data = data or {}
			data.Coins = (data.Coins or 0) + amount
			return data
		end)
	end)

	if success and result then
		return result.Coins
	end

	warn(("Failed to add coins for userId %d: %s"):format(userId, tostring(result)))
	return -1
end

return CoinManager

-- ServerScriptService/CoinsData.lua
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local playerDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function retry(callback)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local success, result = pcall(callback)
		if success then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("DataStore attempt %d failed: %s"):format(attempt, tostring(result)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function saveCoins(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return
	end

	retry(function()
		playerDataStore:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, coins.Value)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local success, savedCoins = retry(function()
		return playerDataStore:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if success and savedCoins then
		coins.Value = savedCoins
	else
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s; starting with 0"):format(player.Name))
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	saveCoins(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

game:BindToClose(function()
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	if #players == 0 then
		return
	end

	local saveCount = 0
	for _, player in players do
		task.spawn(function()
			saveCoins(player)
			saveCount += 1
		end)
	end

	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while saveCount < #players and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)
